messages.subject: Project Aquilo - Calderwater mark-up (v2)
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

Please find attached Calderwater's mark-up of the Master Supply Agreement (v2). The principal points are:

- Liability cap raised to 150% of Charges, with the IP indemnity uncapped and LDs sitting outside the cap
- Minimum commitment shortfall payment deleted (commitment to be a target only)
- Payment terms moved to 60 days
- Warranty extended to 36 months
- Liquidated damages increased to 1%/week, 20% cap, and the "sole remedy" wording removed
- Termination for convenience available at any time on 3 months' notice

We think these are reasonable for a utility customer. Happy to discuss.

Hannah Liu
Thwaite Mercer LLP
